[[Hanjuu's Bludgeoner]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] dropped by [[Hanjuu Towerfist]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Jaya Bluffs]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 13-19 (Requires 6 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:Damage +10% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] gain (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +20

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Bludgeoner]].
